# RegNetX-3.2GF

Classification · `regnet-x3.2gf_224x224` · DX-APP C++ example

Classification model, evaluated on ILSVRC2012.

**Input** 224 × 224 × 3 · **Dataset** ILSVRC2012 · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models RegNetX3_2GF
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target regnet-x3.2gf_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/regnet-x3.2gf_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/regnet-x3.2gf_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/regnet/regnet-x3.2gf_224x224/regnet-x3.2gf_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/regnet-x3.2gf_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 81.18 |
| Q-Lite | 80.75 (−0.43) |
| Q-Pro | 80.86 (−0.32) |

ILSVRC2012 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
